title: Chess.com Grew From 30 Million To 200 Million Accounts
closing: The platform boom is measurable without crediting one show for the whole surge.
question: When did you start playing online?

segments.say: Chess.com reached 200 million registered accounts. Online chess moved far beyond its earlier scale.
Monthly signups reached 2.8 million after the release. The timing shows a spike, not proof of sole causation.
The worldwide estimate was 605 million regular players. One platform still represents only part of global chess.
